instruction: Befriend on Venmo anyone I have sent money to this month.
notes: Single-app task (venmo). The set of people the supervisor sent money to in May 2023 is unknown at modeling time; it is represented by placeholder persons recipient-1 / recipient-2 (declared as domain constants so supervisor-complete-task can require all of them to be friends). The number of recipients (2) is a placeholder chosen to match the 6-API reference solution; at runtime the agent iterates venmo.add_friend over every distinct receiver returned by venmo.show_transactions(direction='sent', min_created_at='2023-05-01T00:00:00'), paging if necessary and skipping anyone who is already a friend (the goal only requires new friendships, no removals). Static init facts sent-money-this-month / email-of describe the hidden world state; knowledge of them is gated by (transactions-listed), which is the effect of the show_transactions lookup. Venmo username is the supervisor's email. No answer is passed to complete_task.
